name: which_order_to_cancel_is_unclear
use_case: Change or cancel an order before it ships
branch: The customer has two processing orders from this morning and requests cancellation without an order number, requiring order disambiguation before cancelling
tests: the agent finds Elena Rostova's two processing orders (O470, O471) via search_orders, clarifies which one to cancel, and cancels only O471 (the T-shirt) upon confirmation while leaving O470 processing

You placed two orders this morning: one for Road Running Shoes and one for an Organic Cotton Crewneck T-Shirt. You want to cancel the T-shirt order. You do not remember your order number. If asked which order or item you want to cancel, state that you want to cancel the T-shirt order. Confirm cancellation when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Elena Rostova
- Email: elena.rostova@example.com
- Postal Code: 94102

persona.name: Elena Rostova
persona.initial_message: Hi, I placed an order this morning for a T-shirt and would like to cancel it, but I don't have the order number handy. My email is elena.rostova@example.com and postal code is 94102.
